input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods does not apply.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law (with CISG disapplied) and Section 28.2 confers exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County, with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue objections — exactly the preferred position. There is no arbitration provision anywhere in the document, so no foreign seat concern. Section 28.3's fifteen-business-day executive escalation is a mutual pre-filing step that expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-preserving filings, and Section 28.2 preserves interim injunctive relief in other courts; neither undercuts the accepted law/forum selection. No redline needed.
